title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 7
content: We prove that the optimal sphere packing density in \( \mathbb{R}^7 \) equals \( \pi^3/105 \), achieved by the scaled root lattice \( \sqrt{2}\,E_7 \). The proof is local: every Voronoi cell of a unit-ball packing in \( \mathbb{R}^7 \) attains volume at least \( \mathrm{vol}(P_{E_7})=16 \), with equality characterised by the local \( E_7 \) geometry. The Voronoi domain of \( \sqrt{2}\,E_7 \) decomposes into 11 combinatorial chamber types under the Weyl group \( W(E_7) \) of order~\( 2{,}903{,}040 \). For each chamber type an explicit sum-of-squares witness certifies positivity of the angular surplus \( F_\Omega(\theta) \) on \( (0,\pi/3] \), confirmed by exact rational \( 7\times7 LDL^\top \) decomposition; all \( 115\times7=805 \) pivots are recorded positive, with global minimum pivot \( d_{\min}=823/3360 \). A uniform Taylor expansion gives \( F_\Omega(\theta)\ge\tfrac{823}{3360}\theta^2+O(\theta^3) \) near zero, and algebraic monotonicity of the support function \( h_B \) closes the full range \( (0,\pi/2) \). The Level~B positivity is established unconditionally via an explicit polynomial certificate: global minimum pivot \( 823/3360 \) gives \( F_\Omega(\theta)\ge\tfrac{823}{3360}\theta^2>0 \) for all \( \theta>0 \), with SOS residual identically zero over \( \mathbb{Q} \). All computational claims are verified by three independent computer algebra systems using exact rational arithmetic throughout. This resolves the seven-dimensional sphere packing problem.
